item.tib: mkha' 'gro dgongs pa kun 'dus kyi rdzogs chen dgongs pa rang grol las spyi 'gro sman gyi rgyal po
item.coloph: ces rdzogs pa chen po mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol gyis (gyi) rgyud las/ spyi 'gro sman gyi rgyal po 'di ni/ bstan sbyin grogs las slob rgyud 'dzin rnams kyi gsang ba'i snying nor du bkod pa dmu rdo'i byang phyogs su/ mi 'gyur drug gi dbus su brjid pa'i dga' ldan g.yung drung gling gi gzim khang rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang du/ sa rta zla ba brgyad pa'i 'phel phyogs su thos chung kun grol grags pas bris pa'o//
